slide.caption: The experience begins in the 1852 Naples Observatory, inviting users to discover the Psyche asteroid through an interactive, period-accurate telescope.
The Chrysalis: Exploring the mythological parallels between the asteroid's dormant state as a planetesimal core and the chrysalis from Greek lore.
Bridging eras by transitioning from historical astronomical observation to the modern-day launch of the 2023 Psyche spacecraft.
The Butterfly: Highlighting the spacecraft's design, where its expansive solar panels symbolize butterfly wings representing the Psyche, "breath of life."
The Mythos: Uniting the scientific mission with the narrative of the Goddess Psyche, framing the exploration of the asteroid as the realization of her immortality.
